audience: lawyers and law firm administrators who manage matters, time and billing in Lawcus

useCases.title: Find matters with their status and trust balance
useCases.text: The AI lists matters filtered by status, name, client or dates, with billing type, trust and retainer balances, and opens one matter for its stage and settings.

useCases.title: Review new leads and where they came from
useCases.text: The AI lists leads with contact details and pipeline stage, and the lead sources and workflow stages, so you see the recent pipeline.

useCases.title: Run billing and receivable reports for a period
useCases.text: The AI reads the accounts receivable, revenue, payments collected and invoice history reports for a period. These reports need the Admin role.

useCases.title: Review time entries, expenses and billing items
useCases.text: The AI lists time entries and expenses by matter and date range, and billable activity by user, practice area or invoiced state, with time totals.

useCases.title: Look up or add a contact
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by name, email or type and opens one, or creates a new person or company contact. Nothing is sent to the contact.

useCases.title: Create a task on a matter and assign it
useCases.text: The AI finds the matter and team members, then creates a task on the matter, assigned to the people you name, with no reminders set.
